# config: git: work with Tact project under @octolab.net

Commit to the Tact project's repositories under the OctoLab identity (`…@octolab.net`) rather than the personal `kamil@samigullin.info`. **Motivation:** legal — the work belongs to the company. Practically: a per-directory or per-repository `user.email`/`user.name`/`signingKey`, applied automatically for the right checkouts (git's `includeIf "gitdir:…"` is the standard mechanism), so that a commit is never made under the wrong identity.
